title: How Many Queens to BEAT Stockfish 17?
summary: Tony plays real Stockfish 17 at depth 35. Game 1 even (loss). Each later game one pawn is replaced by an extra queen. He wins with just 1 extra queen, finishing with a ladder mate.
rules: Game 1 even; after each loss replace one White pawn with a queen.
